- Vocabulary no longer rewrites everyday English words: "rest", "vote", "committee" and "branches" stay as said.
- A word that is both everyday English and a vocabulary term, like "cloud" for Claude, is settled by the cleanup model reading the sentence: "ask cloud" becomes Claude, "the cloud server" stays.
- Gemma 4 E2B can now clean English (Models > Cleanup, English): more accurate than S1-mini in testing, about four times slower.
- Vocabulary > Show advanced can let the instruction model settle those words in English, at the cost of keeping it loaded.
- Correcting a dictation in History offers every swapped word to the vocabulary, not only one.
- "New paragraph" and "new line" work after cleanup has capitalised or punctuated them.
- The external transcription endpoint now receives your vocabulary.
- Qwen3.5 4B is offered as an alternative instruction model.
